races.name: www.tramoreraces.ie Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LLEM'S showed enough in 2 runs last season to suggest he's at least capable of winning a race of this nature. Asthelightdeclines likely has a bigger performance in her and is second choice.

  1. LLEM'S (FR)
  2. ASTHELIGHTDECLINES (IRE)
  3. MATILAUNA (IRE)

races.name: Ardmore Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
LANZHOU shaped well when runner-up here last time and a repeat of that effort should see him go close. Million Dollar Man is in good hands and surely capable of better than he has shown in this sphere so far, while Tingarran Express goes well at this track and is also respected.

  1. LANZHOU (FR)
  2. MILLION DOLLAR MAN (IRE)
  3. TINGARRAN EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TUTU TWIST went like the best horse at the weights in a first-time tongue strap when second at Kilbeggan last month and is selected to go one better. The Willie Mullins-trained pair Blue Trix and Ronnie's Rascal are feared most in that order.

  1. TUTU TWIST (IRE)
  2. BLUE TRIX (IRE)
  3. RONNIE'S RASCAL (IRE)

races.name: Tramore Racecourse On Instagram Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WAY DOWN SOUTH arrives fit from the Flat and looks capable of making an impact back in this sphere from his current mark. Brave Josee rates the main danger on her Sligo second in June, while Nirisque should have more to offer now handicapping.

  1. WAY DOWN SOUTH (IRE)
  2. BRAVE JOSEE (FR)
  3. NIRISQUE (FR)

races.name: Pickardstown Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
LEAVE IN SECRET shaped best when chasing home one that has gone in again since at Wexford last time and looks capable of going one better. Lady Doyanne and Farrokh both arrive in good order and rate the main dangers.

  1. LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)
  2. LADY DOYANNE (IRE)
  3. FARROKH (FR)

races.name: Waterford Greenway Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
RATTLEDELATCH has looked much improved over fences, travelling strongly when runner-up at this course in August before staying on late to finish fourth at Listowel a fortnight ago. He looks the one to beat. Doctor Confusion needs to brush up his jumping but shaped as though this longer trip is worth another go last time, while recent hurdle winner Moonlight Paradise is bred to make at least as good a chaser.

  1. RATTLEDELATCH (IRE)
  2. DOCTOR CONFUSION (FR)
  3. MOONLIGHT PARADISE (IRE)

races.name: Copper Coast (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
COLOSSAL IMPACT's debut effort is supported by a strong timefigure so he appeals as a solid candidate. Long Goodbye was beaten only by the promising Boycetown at Down Royal last Christmas and has a solid chance if returning to a similar level, while Josh's Jury may raise his game for his new yard.

  1. COLOSSAL IMPACT
  2. LONG GOODBYE (FR)
  3. JOSH'S JURY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
The market should prove highly informative but Dermot Weld's SILVER KISS holds the clear edge on form so is taken to build on a good Punchestown second and get off the mark. Chattering Classes shaped well when a debut fourth at the Curragh and appeals as the one to chase her home. Joseph O'Brien's debutants Light of Saxony and Kathy M can't be discounted either, especially if the market vibes are positive.

  1. SILVER KISS (IRE)
  2. CHATTERING CLASSES (IRE)
  3. LIGHT OF SAXONY (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
KING CHRISTOPH finished a promising second on debut at Listowel and may well go one better here. Group 1-entered Dawnmore probably did too much too soon when third in the same maiden and has to be feared, while Battle Ready is no back number on his Leopardstown form.

  1. KING CHRISTOPH (IRE)
  2. DAWNMORE (IRE)
  3. BATTLE READY (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
THE BLUE PANTHER is taken to go one better than on stable debut. Hat-trick seeking Starflow rates the chief threat, ahead of Free Solo and Imperial Dream.

  1. THE BLUE PANTHER (IRE)
  2. STARFLOW (IRE)
  3. FREE SOLO (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DUCHESS ANNE has responded well to positive rides this year, going closer than she ever has when finishing a neck second at Punchestown 23 days ago. She could well prove tough to peg back returned to a shorter trip and earns the vote. Glamazon also ran well on her latest outing and is feared for a new yard, with Princess Chloe and last year's winner Queen Aethelflaed others to consider.

  1. DUCHESS ANNE (IRE)
  2. GLAMAZON (IRE)
  3. PRINCESS CHLOE (IRE)

races.name: Welcome Back To Thurles Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
GLEN ECHO is steadily going the right way in handicaps, enhancing his form further when posting a very good second at Roscommon 38 days ago. He looks to hold solid claims of going one place better, with Red Glory who has developed into a fairly useful hurdler since last seen on the Flat another key player. Felicity Smoak and Max Meridius also make each-way appeal.

  1. GLEN ECHO (IRE)
  2. RED GLORY (IRE)
  3. FELICITY SMOAK (IRE)

races.name: Killinan Handicap
races.verdict:
CLADACH has been shaping well without getting his head in front and is taken to gain a deserved breakthrough victory now stepped up in trip off a still handy-looking mark. Jessica Harrington's Listowel maiden victor The Austrian looks to have more to offer on his handicap debut and is the chief threat.

  1. CLADACH (IRE)
  2. THE AUSTRIAN (IRE)
  3. PIERRE GROSSE

races.name: www.thurlesraces.ie Maiden
races.verdict:
SHIRZAN was first past the post on her Flat debut at Tramore only to be disqualified for her rider weighing in light and she can gain compensation on the back of 2 very good efforts over hurdles. Sunny South West heads the list of dangers with this step up in trip a positive, while Yogini and Teofil also warrant plenty of respect in this fascinating maiden.

  1. SHIRZAN (IRE)
  2. SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)
  3. YOGINI (IRE)

races.name: Racing Here On The 12th November Handicap
races.verdict:
BLISSFUL BONITA remains on a steady upward curve and is taken to get off the mark with the step up in trip sure to suit. Granville Street is potentially on a good mark back down in class and is next best ahead of the in-form Miss Australie.

  1. BLISSFUL BONITA (IRE)
  2. GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)
  3. MISS AUSTRALIE (IRE)

races.name: Summer Plate Ladies Day 2027 On Sale Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KNIGHTON can make a winning return if putting it all together. Latin appeals as a likely danger following an eye-catching stable debut. Ballygeary and Paddys Policy complete the shortlist.

  1. KNIGHTON
  2. LATIN (IRE)
  3. PADDYS POLICY (IRE)

races.name: Tractor Drivers Go Free On 12th November Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NIGHTFLYER has had the form of his Uttoxeter win boosted by the second scoring at Kelso on Sunday and is the percentage call, although strong support for Irish point recruit Port Glen One would put a slightly different slant on things.

  1. NIGHTFLYER (GER)
  2. PORT GLEN ONE (IRE)
  3. WHO'S GLEN (FR)

races.name: Malton Marquees Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
WHITEWINEWEDNESDAY goes off the same mark as when landing a Sedgefield handicap hurdle under Patrick Mullins last week so this former point winner looks sure to make a bold bid if taking to fences. Walk In The Valley is another with a pointing background and the fact his good second in a course handicap hurdle last November came off a 9-month lay-off suggests his absence since may not be an issue.

  1. WHITEWINEWEDNESDAY (IRE)
  2. WALK IN THE VALLEY (IRE)
  3. CAP RICOCHET

races.name: Dine In Altior's Restaurant Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Possible to make a case for all of these but COURT IN A STORM contested a Worcester race last time which has worked out well and is taken to gain compensation for his late fall there. Lermoos Legend was lobbing along nicely when an unlucky faller at Stratford on Monday and might be the one to give him most to do.

  1. COURT IN A STORM (IRE)
  2. LERMOOS LEGEND
  3. THICKTHORN TOM (IRE)

races.name: Market Rasen Racecourse Caravan Park Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
It's hard to get away from SPOT ON SOPH, who is unpenalised for an emphatic double success at Southwell last week. The fly in the ointment could be Spit Spot, while Leave Her To Me should be thereabouts if building on last time.

  1. SPOT ON SOPH (IRE)
  2. SPIT SPOT
  3. LEAVE HER TO ME

races.name: Book Boxing Day At The Races Today! Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
UPTON'S MIGHTY OAK has the potential to do better over a longer trip on handicap debut. She's narrowly preferred to Ratemenow, who finished last season on a high, while Footage Detectives is another potential improver in a tricky finale.

  1. UPTON'S MIGHTY OAK
  2. RATEMENOW (IRE)
  3. FOOTAGE DETECTIVES

races.name: Your Elite Club Handicap
races.verdict:
PACIFIC STORM is bred to stay very well and might be worth chancing making his handicap debut in a visor. Recent course winner Fram Castle is respected over this longer trip, with Al's River completing the shortlist.

  1. PACIFIC STORM (FR)
  2. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  3. AL'S RIVER (IRE)

races.name: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KERRY GREY made up plenty of late ground at Wolverhampton on debut and Richard Hughes' filly is expected to build on that. Pontefract third Casting Coach and Chanter Le Blues, who made an encouraging start back in the spring, are also shortlisted.

  1. KERRY GREY
  2. CASTING COACH
  3. CHANTER LE BLUES (IRE)

races.name: MDA Consulting Ltd Handicap
races.verdict:
SAVANNAH SMILES has fallen to her last winning mark and looks ready to strike again judged on her eyecatching run here last week. Pedros Dream showed much more when second on his handicap bow at Windsor so is next best ahead of fellow 3-y-o Little Jaybee, who is building up a good record for her current yard.

  1. SAVANNAH SMILES (IRE)
  2. PEDROS DREAM
  3. LITTLE JAYBEE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Beckford Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This longer distance is sure to suit BRILLIANT STAR given how she shaped in the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot and she is preferred to Pierian, who looks ready for another crack at this level, particularly now upped in trip. Venetia can make it a clean sweep for the 3-y-os.

  1. BRILLIANT STAR
  2. PIERIAN
  3. VENETIA

races.name: Seat Unique EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
AETHELSTAN GOLD, Galimix and Charmed Boy all offered plenty to work on first-time out and they are preferred in that order. Mystic Shadow looks the clear pick of the newcomers.

  1. AETHELSTAN GOLD
  2. GALIMIX (IRE)
  3. CHARMED BOY (IRE)

races.name: Find My Hospitality Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ALBUS ANNE has fine a record at Bath and with conditions likely to suit, she can build on her promising effort at Salisbury. Top-weight Crimson Road is also high on the shortlist alongside recent Haydock winner Condotti.

  1. ALBUS ANNE
  2. CRIMSON ROAD (IRE)
  3. CONDOTTI (IRE)

races.name: Find My Hospitality Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ZAMBEZI MAGIC has won 2 of his last 3 starts and the veteran can defy a 4 lb rise for his latest Ffos Las success. Ablon is respected after a short break, with Pipily perhaps likeliest to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. ZAMBEZI MAGIC
  2. ABLON (FR)
  3. PIPILY

races.name: MJ Church Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
COURAGEOUS SIOUX can maintain an unbeaten start for the Clive Cox yard and complete the hat-trick at the chief expense of recent Southwell winner Court Drive and C&D specialist Moe's Legacy.

  1. COURAGEOUS SIOUX
  2. COURT DRIVE (IRE)
  3. MOE'S LEGACY

races.name: Spillers ULCA Fibre Handicap Stakes (0-55) - Arab Race
Stella Artois Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MOTAWAARED hasn't done much wrong of late and perhaps this is the day he finally gets his head in front. Falcon Nine is another who has been knocking on the door in recent starts and is second choice under Jack Nicholls. Newmarket raider Ghost Story is next on the list.

  1. MOTAWAARED
  2. FALCON NINE
  3. GHOST STORY (IRE)

races.name: Menabrea Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CATURRA ROCK's opening Yarmouth second came at big odds but there appeared to be no fluke about it and he's taken to go one better now. Sea Mirage and Muve On are the pair likely to give him most to do.

  1. CATURRA ROCK
  2. SEA MIRAGE (IRE)
  3. MUVE ON

races.name: Heverlee Handicap
races.verdict:
Irish raider LAUNCH TIME should relish conditions, and he's narrowly preferred to interesting turf debutant Thunder Rush. Big Apple Jack looks the pick of the remainder.

  1. LAUNCH TIME
  2. THUNDER RUSH
  3. BIG APPLE JACK

races.name: Tennent's Lager Handicap
races.verdict:
TOPWARRIOR looks to have plenty in his favour following a near miss at Hamilton last time. He may gain compensation at the expense of Alpha Magic, who caught the eye in defeat at Pontefract last time, while Parisiac is likely to be knocking on the door again. Bronze Cup winner Eye Of Dubai isn't taken lightly back under these conditions, either.

  1. TOPWARRIOR
  2. ALPHA MAGIC
  3. PARISIAC (IRE)

races.name: San Miguel Handicap
races.verdict:
Veteran EMPIRESTATEOFMIND arrives in fine fettle and goes unpenalised for his comfortable apprentice riders handicap success here under similar ground conditions so gets the vote. Stanage caught the eye when a fast-finishing third over C&D last time and seems sure to be on the premises, while Valentine Catcher is knocking on the door again and also commands plenty of respect. Cisco Disco and One Night Thunder also need factoring into this highly competitive sprint.

  1. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)
  2. STANAGE
  3. VALENTINE CATCHER

races.name: Outcider Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty look potentially well handicapped on the best of their soft-ground form, including TORALOU, who makes plenty of each-way appeal in a wide-open contest. Keats House is feared most if headgear continues to have the same effect. Interesting last-time-out winners Evelyn's Phoenix and Rory's Gold are possible pace angles in the race, along with 3-time C&D winner Penelope's Sister.

  1. TORALOU (IRE)
  2. KEATS HOUSE (IRE)
  3. EVELYN'S PHOENIX (FR)

races.name: Magners Original Cider Handicap
races.verdict:
None of the quintet can be ruled out but it's hard to side against AIGHEAR who scored in fine style here last week and can make light of a 4-lb penalty and follow up her victory in this 12 months ago. Recent Hamilton winners Wootton's Gal (second choice) and Off Spin can fight it out for minor honours.

  1. AIGHEAR
  2. WOOTTON'S GAL
  3. OFF SPIN (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Nursery
races.verdict:
ROXA LOVE had a bit up her sleeve when doubling her tally at Wolverhampton last month and with further progress on the cards now tackling a nursery, George Boughey's filly can complete the hat-trick. Things haven't gone to plan for Minzelle since getting off the mark, but she can get back on track on all-weather debut, with Needin' U and Paper View taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. ROXA LOVE
  2. MINZELLE (IRE)
  3. NEEDIN' U

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
RUBELLITE already has 3 wins for new connections this year and having found the much slacker pace against her at Newcastle recently, Stephen Hanlon's mare is fancied to get back on the up. She can get the better of Edwardtheninth, who bolted up over C&D last month and a 7 lb rise may prove on the lenient side. Lady of Clover and Wedonttellthetruth can fight out minor honours.

  1. RUBELLITE (IRE)
  2. EDWARDTHENINTH
  3. LADY OF CLOVER (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A few in with chances but SUMMER IN PARIS matched the pick of her efforts for James Owen when finishing runner-up at Leicester recently and with this slightly longer trip holding no fears, she gets the nod to get off the mark. Crown of Crowns should take a marked step forward from her recent Windsor debut, so she heads up the dangers, with Master of The Sky a newcomer to note representing powerful connections.

  1. SUMMER IN PARIS
  2. CROWN OF CROWNS
  3. MASTER OF THE SKY

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Nursery (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for any number of these but the most persuasive is for COURAGE BEST, who ran easily her best race when finishing runner-up at Brighton recently and Rod Millman's filly can go one better on her all-weather debut. Casablanca Dream upped her game tackling her first nursery at Yarmouth 3 weeks ago, so she looks an obvious threat, with Thunda Struck and Kaito both warranting plenty of respect, too.

  1. COURAGE BEST (IRE)
  2. CASABLANCA DREAM (IRE)
  3. THUNDA STRUCK (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Nursery (Div 2)
races.verdict:
REVOKED still looked a work in progress when third over 7f here 2 weeks ago but makes most appeal in a thin-looking race. Astral Calling is of interest based on her Musselburgh second, whilst nursery newcomer Mohangel should benefit from this longer trip.

  1. REVOKED (IRE)
  2. ASTRAL CALLING (IRE)
  3. MOHANGEL

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
POETS PRAISE looks an upwardly-mobile filly for the Ralph Beckett yard and she's fancied to follow up her facile handicap debut success. Lovers Leap has been expensive to follow so far in handicaps but her track position provides a viable excuse last time, with Wondrous Light also on the shortlist.

  1. POETS PRAISE
  2. LOVERS LEAP (IRE)
  3. WONDROUS LIGHT

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
races.verdict:
ERNIE'S VALENTINE looked back in form when runner-up at C&D 3 weeks ago and he can go one place better from a very workable mark. Captain Cess, Spirit Lead Me and Have You A Minute are also shortlisted.

  1. ERNIE'S VALENTINE
  2. CAPTAIN CESS (IRE)
  3. SPIRIT LEAD ME (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DORIGO sets a tall standard on what he has achieved in much stronger company than this to date and looks tough to oppose back on all-weather for the first time since his debut. Edge of Desire is a newcomer to note, whilst Cool King and Christmas Is Comin look best of the others boasting previous experience.

  1. DORIGO (IRE)
  2. EDGE OF DESIRE
  3. COOL KING

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap
races.verdict:
NOT THAT GUY built on his exploits as a juvenile and made light of an 11-month absence in the process when successful in a 12-runner Wolverhampton novice 23 days ago. That form is already working out well and from what looks a handy opening mark on handicap debut, he makes plenty of appeal with the step up to 7f looking likely to suit. This is competitive, though, with recent course winner Nostrum, Billyb and 4-time C&D winner King of Ithaca just 3 potential threats.

  1. NOT THAT GUY (IRE)
  2. NOSTRUM
  3. BILLYB (FR)
